description:
One-screen weather: now, the next 24 hours, the next 7 days. No tracking.

A privacy-first, simplicity-first weather app. One screen: current conditions, the next 24 hours, the next 7 days.

Named for the weather balloon, the humble instrument that gathers a forecast's raw truth and reports back, nothing more. On the home screen the current temperature wears a sun halo, flanked by two bright companion spots.

Privacy

  • Weather and place search come from Open-Meteo: keyless, no account, no tracking. You can point the app at your own Open-Meteo server instead (HTTPS only).
  • The radar card (US only) shows NOAA NEXRAD imagery from the Iowa Environmental Mesonet, fetched only while the card is open. Tile requests carry no coordinates, just which ~240 km map squares are in view. The base map is built into the app from public-domain Census and Natural Earth data and makes no requests at all.
  • Only two permissions: INTERNET and ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION. Location is optional: pin a place by search and revoke it entirely.
  • Coordinates are rounded to ~1 km before any request leaves the device.
  • The town name in the header comes from the device's geocoder where one exists, sent the rounded coordinates only. Devices without a geocoder just show "My location".
  • No Play Services, no analytics, no third-party SDKs. Networking is plain HttpURLConnection.
  • The last good forecast is cached locally so the app works offline.
